relationships.subject: anastrozole
relationships.evidence_quote: Anastrozole caused mechanical allodynia and muscle strength loss in mice.

relationships.subject: HC067047
relationships.evidence_quote: HC067047, TRPV4 antagonist, reduced the anastrozole-induced mechanical allodynia and muscle strength loss.

relationships.subject: B2 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: The generation of painful conditions caused by anastrozole depends on direct TRPV4 activation or indirect, e.g., PLC, PKC and PKCε pathways downstream from B<sub>2</sub>R and B<sub>1</sub>R activation.

relationships.subject: PLC/PKC/PKCε pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, inhibition of PLC, PKC or PKCε attenuated the mechanical allodynia and muscle strength loss induced by TRPV4, B<sub>2</sub>R and B<sub>1</sub>R agonists.

key_findings: TRPV4 mediates anastrozole-induced musculoskeletal pain in mice.
B1R and B2R sensitize TRPV4 via PLC, PKC and PKCε.
